tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// dzambha la nag po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// sgrub thabs brgya rtsa las byung ba// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ utstshuṣma dzambha la sā dha naṃ/ bod skad du/ utstshuṣma dzambha la'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ bcom ldan 'das dzambha la la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ āḥzhes bya bas phab ste/ rang gi snying gar a yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i lte ba'i dbus su dbang po sbas pa

mthing nag lta bu'i hūm̐ yig go /sngon du bstan pa'i 'bebs pa'i sngags kyis phab la/ dzambha la mgon po rang gi snying gar rab tu bcug la utstshuṣma mi'u thung gi gzugs rna ba ma phug pa/ mdog gnag pa/ skra kham pa gyen du 'greng ba/ lus thung bar byed cing khro gnyer can mche ba dang ldan pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbu rgyan can/ klu chen po brgyad kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ g.yon pa'i phyag na nor bu la sogs pa skyugs pa'i ne'u le bsnams pa/ g.yas na khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa'o// mgo bo g.yas phyogs su bstan pa'i gser gyi mdog can/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i nor sbyin 'gyel ba la zhabs gnyis kyis mnan pas rin po che'i snye ma la sogs pa skyugs par byed pa'o// 'od 'phro ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i bdag nyid du bsams la/ utstshuṣma'i g.yas pa'i phyag tu oṃ las skyes pa gru gsum pa'i swa sti ka nor bu dga' 'khyil bsam mo// bam̐ las skyes pa'i bum pa bzang po 'bo bzhin pa'o// lag pa'i dbus su dzam mo// sdigs mdzub la bha'o// gung mo la'o// srin lag la dza'o// mthe'u chung la len no// mtheb chen la drā'o// mkhrig mgul du ya'o// de nas swā hā zhes bya ba ni logs gnyis la'o// sngags dgod pa bsgom pa'i rim pa'o// khar mngon par bsngags la chu sbyin par bya'o// oṃ dza lum̐ swā hā/ chu khyor ba nas sbyin pa'i sngags so// oṃ ind+rā ṇi mu khaṃ bhra ma ri swā hā/ lag pa nas kha/ kha nas lag pa/ de nas zhal du sbyin par bya'o// de ltar snying rjes sems can dbul ba'i sdug bsngal gcad pa'i don du dzambha la bsgoms pas ni dzambha la nyid du 'gyur ba'o// utstshuṣma dzambha la'i sgrub thabs rnal 'byor pa dga' ba sbyin gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// paṇḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong ba ri rin chen grags pas bsgyur ba'o//

༈ /utstshuṣma dzambha la'i sgrub thabs la/ dzambha la la chu ster ba ni/ dbul po'i don du 'phags pa byung bas dbul po la chu min pa med pas des 'phags pa chus mnyes so// gzhan dbu'i rma la ldugs zer pa dang nor bu med yod zer ba la sogs pa ni gyi na'o gsung ngo*// tshogs gnyis gzhan dang mthun par bsags la/ de nas lus sgyu ma tsam gyi snying gar pad nyi la hūm̐/ de las rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i rim pa las bskyed do// yang na tshogs bsag mi dgos so// sgrub pa pos sems bskyed de/ ngag tu oṃ āḥzhes pas nam mkha' la gnas pa skad cig gis bkug la rang la gzhug go /de nas snying gar pad zla'i steng du hūm̐ dmar po las rdo rje rtse dgu pa lte ba la dbang po sbas pa lta bu'i hūm̐ bltas te de shing thog gi ming ngo*// hūm̐ de las 'od kyi tshul du dzambha la nam mkha' la spros la/ ngag tu oṃ āḥzhes pas nam mkha' las phab ste/ lus kun gyur pa las utstshuṣma mi'u thung 'dra ba bskyed do// rin 'byung gis rang chas su dbur brgyan pa/ klu chen po brgyad ni/ klu rigs bzhi las gnyis gnyis so// lhag ma can gyis ni se ral khar ro// 'og tu nor sbyin ser po 'gyel ba mgo g.yas su bstan pa/ kha nas ratna'i snye ma skyugs pa zhabs kyis mnan pa'o// sgrub cing bsgom pa de ltar ro// de nas chu sbyin pa ni thod pa mi dmigs par byas la utstshuṣma'i phyag g.yas par oṃ las gru gsum pa cig bsam ste/ de la swa sti ka zhes bya ba'i gru gsum nang du bam̐ las bum pa bzang po bdud rtsi 'bo bzhin pa cig bsam mo// yi ge dgod pa ni lag pa'i dbus su bum pa'i rtsar dzam̐/ swā dang hā gnyis lag pa'i zur gnyis la/ de nas ind+rā ṇi'i sngags re brjod pas kha bsngags te/ khar chu khyor gang blugs te/ de nas yang kha nas khyor bar blugs te/ oṃ dza lum̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod pas dzambha la'i zhal du brgya rtsa brgyad dbul lo// de yang dzambha la'i lugs sku nag po mdun du bzhugs pa la ye shes pa bstim pa la bya'o// sku med na gong ltar ro// kha cig na re/

g.yas oṃ las gru gsum pa ni nor sbyin gyi lag pa yin zer te/ utstshuṣma bde'o// sems can gyi dbul ba'i sdug bsngal zhi bar bya ba'i don du de bsgom na myur du de 'dra ba'i nor 'ong bar 'gyur ro// bzlas pa bya lugs mi gsung*// / bla ma sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa'o// ༈ /'phags pa dzambha la nag po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ dzambha la nag po bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma zla ba'i steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid mgon po dzambha la sku mdog nag po mi'u thung gi gzugs can/ gsus pa 'phyang ba/ gcer bu rna ba ma phug pa/ skra kham pa gyen du brdzes shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas na thod pa khrag gis gang ba dang*/ g.yon na rin po che sna tshogs skyugs pa'i ne'u le 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pa'i stabs kyis nor bdag ser po rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ gan rkyal du 'gyel ba'i kha nas rin po che sna tshogs skyugs pa mnan pa/ sku las 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad dzambha la'i rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ oṃ badzrī bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ thugs kar hūm̐ gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor bar sems gtad la/

oṃ dzambha la dza lend+rā ya swā hā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ ind+rā ṇi mu khaṃ bhra ma ri swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzla/ mthar gdan rnams 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te/ rang la thim par bsams la/ dge ba bsngo// rjes gnang byed na mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ bdag bskyed gong bzhin bya/ tshom bu lhar bskyed/ mchod bstod/ a kā ro'i sngags kyis gtor ma phul la bzlas pa bya/ slob mas maṇḍal phul la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// zhes sogs dang*/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pas bdag la 'phags pa dzambha la'i rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ zhes pa rnams lan gsum gsum dang gzhi dgod pa'i slad du slob ma la bskyed bstim bya/ rjes su bzlas pa lan gsum dang*/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs brjod/ dam bca' ba spyi dang mthun/ byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir du rigs 'dra bstim/ gtso bos sogs 'dra/ rjes mchod bstod byas te/ ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bsdus la bkra shis bya'o// zhes pa 'di yang don gnyer 'ga' zhig la phan pa'i phyir/ shākya'i dge slong dkon mchog lhun grub kyis sbyar ba'o// //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
